scope_summary: Freeze the journal Beta machine contract and typed parity checks, including repeat/overlap/incremental IBKR source-bound semantics without claiming the later implementation exists.

Keep the unsafe legacy generic Import deny-only until JRN-011/JRN-012: three API paths return FEATURE_DISABLED, stay out of OpenAPI, do not import the in-memory handler, and have no usable frontend surface.
Enforce deployment ceiling AND runtime rollout for optional capabilities, with committed-state connection SAVEPOINT reads that do not flush or poison caller pending state.
Enforce raw ASCII-before-trim full instrument identity and HEDGE_BY_DIRECTION same-side OPEN rejection from canonical truth even when mutable legacy status, direction, or symbol drifts.
Keep pre-upgrade identity projection read-only across check-open and every direct canonical financial write; only exact journal_identity_v1 evidence may authorize ADD, reversal, or dividend mutation.
Treat missing canonical quantity as unresolved and therefore slot-occupying; response direction and drift metrics use the same canonical side even when legacy direction drifts.

Remove client-asserted X-Migration-Fallback authority from every public legacy review/delete/batch mutation, OpenAPI, and product UI; those mutations now fail closed until an audited admin/CLI namespace exists.
Preserve structured OPEN_POSITION_EXISTS position identity so a frontend submit race can recover into the canonical ADD flow without a legacy batch write.
Keep global AssetMetadata system-owned and project canonical instrument identity/status/side across create, list, detail, filters, and check-open.
Add real Playwright behavior coverage at 1440x900 and 390x844, including keyboard semantics and the complete 409-to-canonical-ADD recovery, plus a versioned exact-SHA added-line secret scanner.
Prove connection SAVEPOINT failure recovery and caller pending-state isolation against a disposable real PostgreSQL 16 cluster rather than SQLite alone.

findings: Canonical same-side OPEN could be duplicated after mutable legacy status or direction drift.
Truth-present identity without exact journal_identity_v1 proof was promoted from legacy columns.
Symbol filtering used raw legacy storage while responses used canonical projection.
Session.begin_nested flushed unrelated pending state before the runtime-flag SAVEPOINT and could poison the caller session.
Legacy Import could write a user-owned Position against another user's account and bypass canonical identity/atomicity.
Read-only pre-upgrade identity could enter check-open and subsequent ADD.
OPEN_POSITION_EXISTS discarded position_public_id in the frontend and could not recover a submit race into ADD.
Source-regex tests did not satisfy the real component/browser behavior Definition of Done.
Focused backend suite was a label rather than an executable command.
Alembic and diff checks were not bound to the recorded base..checkpoint range.
Credential scan omitted its executable command, rule digest, and exact SHA range.
Direct canonical ADD/reversal/dividend routes did not require exact journal_identity_v1 provenance, so read-only pre-upgrade truth could still receive financial writes.
NULL canonical opened/closed quantity was coerced to zero and could incorrectly release the HEDGE_BY_DIRECTION same-side slot.
Response direction used canonical side while drift risk calculations still used mutable legacy direction.
Connection SAVEPOINT failure recovery and pending-state isolation had only SQLite evidence despite PostgreSQL-specific aborted-transaction semantics.

Public legacy review/delete/batch endpoints trusted client-supplied X-Migration-Fallback headers without admin authorization, reason, or immutable audit; the product UI exposed the batch bypass via a query parameter.
The duplicate-OPEN race browser test stopped after showing the recovery prompt and did not prove the subsequent canonical ADD or zero legacy batch writes.
New-position identity labels and LONG/SHORT controls lacked complete programmatic and keyboard-accessible semantics.
The checkpoint claimed SAVEPOINT failure recovery without any real PostgreSQL command or result; SQLite cannot prove PostgreSQL aborted-transaction recovery.
